headline: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir sworn in as 23rd president of Bangladesh
summary: The swearing-in ceremony took place at Bangabhaban, where the new president took his oath of office.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has officially taken the oath of office as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. The ceremony was held at Bangabhaban, the official residence of the president.
Following the swearing-in, President Mirza Fakhrul received congratulations from the presidents of India and Pakistan, as well as other international leaders.
The event also saw the swearing-in of several new ministers who will join the Tarique-led cabinet, although their specific portfolios are still pending.
The ceremony marks a significant transition in the leadership of the country's head of state.
caption:
Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is now the 23rd President of Bangladesh.

Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has officially taken the oath of office as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. The ceremony was held at Bangabhaban, the official residence of the president.

Following the swearing-in, President Mirza Fakhrul received congratulations from the presidents of India and Pakistan, as well as other international leaders.

The event also saw the swearing-in of several new ministers who will join the Tarique-led cabinet, although their specific portfolios are still pending.

The ceremony marks a significant transition in the leadership of the country's head of state.

headline: PM Tarique expands cabinet with 5 new members, promotes one to minister
summary: The cabinet now stands at 55 members, including the Prime Minister, following the swearing-in of new ministers and state ministers at Bangabhaban.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman expanded his cabinet today, bringing in five new members and elevating one current state minister to full ministerial rank.
BNP Standing Committee Member Abdul Moyeen Khan, Bangladesh Jaitya Party (BJP) Chairman Andaleeve Rahman, and BNP lawmaker Sa Ching Pru took the oath as ministers.
Rashiduzzaman Millat, previously the State Minister for Civil Aviation and Tourism, was promoted to full minister.
BNP MP Shamim Kaiser Lincoln and Foreign Affairs Adviser Humaiun Kobir were sworn in as state ministers.
The oath was administered by Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir at Bangabhaban, shortly after he took his own oath as president.
The cabinet now consists of 55 members: the Prime Minister, 28 ministers, and 27 state ministers.
This follows an initial 49-member cabinet formed on February 17, which included 25 ministers and 24 state ministers.

The expansion comes after several changes, including the appointment of Ahmed Azam Khan as head of the Liberation War Affairs Ministry and the resignation of CHT Affairs Minister Dipen Dewan due to health reasons.
caption:
PM Tarique Rahman has expanded his cabinet to 55 members, adding five new faces and promoting one state minister.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman expanded his cabinet today, bringing in five new members and elevating one current state minister to full ministerial rank.

BNP Standing Committee Member Abdul Moyeen Khan, Bangladesh Jaitya Party (BJP) Chairman Andaleeve Rahman, and BNP lawmaker Sa Ching Pru took the oath as ministers.

Rashiduzzaman Millat, previously the State Minister for Civil Aviation and Tourism, was promoted to full minister.

BNP MP Shamim Kaiser Lincoln and Foreign Affairs Adviser Humaiun Kobir were sworn in as state ministers.

The oath was administered by Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir at Bangabhaban, shortly after he took his own oath as president.

The cabinet now consists of 55 members: the Prime Minister, 28 ministers, and 27 state ministers.

This follows an initial 49-member cabinet formed on February 17, which included 25 ministers and 24 state ministers.

The expansion comes after several changes, including the appointment of Ahmed Azam Khan as head of the Liberation War Affairs Ministry and the resignation of CHT Affairs Minister Dipen Dewan due to health reasons.
